About Our Client:

Our client is one of Nigeria's leading electricity distribution companies, responsible for the distribution and retail supply of electricity within its licensed territory. The company serves customers across the Southern zone, with a strong focus on delivering reliable, efficient, and customer-centric electricity services.

Job Objective:

To lead the organization's internal audit, enterprise risk management, and taxation functions by providing independent assurance, strengthening governance frameworks, ensuring regulatory and tax compliance, mitigating strategic and operational risks, and enhancing long-term organizational value and financial sustainability.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide independent and objective assurance to the Board and Executive Management on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, and compliance frameworks across the organization.
  • Develop and implement a risk-based annual audit strategy and plan that addresses key financial, operational, regulatory, information technology, and strategic risks.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of internal control systems and recommend improvements to safeguard assets, enhance operational efficiency, ensure data integrity, and strengthen organizational performance.
  • Present audit findings, risk exposures, and control deficiencies to the Board Audit & Risk Committee and Executive Management, while monitoring the timely implementation of agreed corrective actions.
  • Lead and maintain the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, ensuring effective identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting of strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee enterprise-wide risk assessments and risk profiling exercises, ensuring critical risks are appropriately escalated and integrated into strategic decision-making processes.
  • Direct fraud risk management initiatives, including fraud prevention, investigation, whistleblowing administration, and the promotion of ethical conduct in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for the organization's taxation function, ensuring compliance with all applicable tax laws, regulations, and statutory obligations.
  • Drive tax planning and tax risk management strategies that optimize tax efficiency, support business objectives, and minimize exposure to financial and regulatory penalties.
  • Oversee the timely preparation, review, and submission of statutory tax returns, remittances, and regulatory disclosures, ensuring full compliance with relevant tax authorities.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors, regulatory agencies, tax authorities, and other assurance providers, ensuring effective coordination and resolution of audit, risk, and tax matters.
  • Advise the Board and Executive Management on emerging risks, regulatory developments, governance trends, and assurance matters that may impact organizational performance and sustainability.
  • Champion a strong culture of risk awareness, accountability, compliance, and internal control through organization-wide communication, education, and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
  • Provide strategic leadership, mentorship, and capability development for the Internal Audit, Risk, and Taxation functions to ensure high performance, talent development, succession readiness, and continuous improvement.
  • Prepare and present integrated assurance, risk, compliance, and taxation reports to the Board and Executive Management, providing insights that support informed decision-making, organizational resilience, and sustainable value creation.
  • Promote and demonstrate leadership commitment to Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental (HSSE) standards by ensuring compliance with relevant policies, regulations, and safe work practices within areas of responsibility.

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Banking & Finance, or a related discipline from a recognized institution. A master's degree or MBA in a relevant field is required.
  • A professional accounting qualification such as ACA (ICAN) or ACCA is mandatory. Additional certifications including CIA, CRMA, CISA, CFE, FRM, or CITN will be an added advantage.
  • A minimum of 18 years of relevant post-qualification experience spanning internal audit, enterprise risk management, taxation, governance, and compliance, including at least 10 years in a senior leadership position responsible for enterprise-wide assurance, risk oversight, and strategic decision support.

Key Performance Metric:

  • Annual Risk-Based Audit Plan Delivery: Achieve 100% execution of the Board-approved annual risk-based audit plan within the financial year, with all high-risk areas reviewed and reported.
  • Audit Recommendation Implementation Rate: Ensure at least 90% implementation of agreed audit actions within approved timelines and achieve zero repeat high-risk audit findings.
  • Enterprise Risk Management Effectiveness: Maintain 100% of critical enterprise risks with approved mitigation plans and ensure quarterly review and reporting of the enterprise risk register to Executive Management and the Board.

Job Title: Operational Excellence Leader

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

The Operational Excellence Leader is responsible for leading the Canadian Service Tools and Operational Supplies programs, ensuring Field Service teams have access to the tools, equipment, and support required to deliver safe, effective, and efficient customer service. This includes leadership of tool strategy, procurement, calibration and repair, supplier management, inventory and lifecycle management, field support, and financial stewardship of the Service Tools program.

In addition, the role drives operational excellence across the Canadian Service organization through improved operational rigor, performance metrics, quality and compliance, process improvement, and readiness for evolving service processes and technologies. Key accountabilities include Daily Management System (DMS) preparedness and dashboard alignment, Service Request cleanup and ServiceMax preparedness, quality initiatives including Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), and the implementation of sustainable operating mechanisms that improve service performance.

The role works cross-functionally with Service leadership, Field Service, Quality, Engineering, Sourcing, operational support teams, suppliers, and regional and global partners to translate business and field requirements into effective solutions and continuous improvement.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities


Service Tools, Operational Supplies & Financial Management

  • Provide overall leadership for the Canadian Service Tools and Operational Supplies programs, including tool availability, procurement, calibration, repair, field support, inventory, catalog management, and lifecycle requirements.
  • Manage the $1.25M+ annual Service Tools budget, including annual planning, prioritization of investments, and alignment with Regional and National Service leadership.
  • Manage calibration and repair suppliers, including work-in-progress reviews, prioritization of high-demand tools, cost management, and resolution of supplier performance issues.
  • Partner with Engineering, Sourcing, Supplier Quality, operational support teams, and other stakeholders to resolve tool availability, obsolescence, validation, quality, and procurement issues.
  • Provide governance for the Operational Supplies catalog, inventory requirements, associated workflows, and supporting data.
  • Serve as an escalation point for Field Service tool requirements, identifying solutions and alternatives that support field productivity and customer service.

Systems & Performance

  • Drive operational rigor across the Service organization through effective performance metrics, operating mechanisms, action management, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead Daily Management System (DMS) preparedness and dashboard alignment, ensuring operational processes, metrics, data, and ownership support business requirements.
  • Lead and support Service Request cleanup and ServiceMax preparedness, including process readiness, testing, data quality, and resolution of workflow gaps.
  • Identify operational performance gaps and partner with Service leaders and cross-functional teams to establish actions, ownership, and sustainable solutions.
  • Support implementation of new processes, systems, metrics, and operational initiatives that improve Service effectiveness.

Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with Quality and Service stakeholders to support Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities, new quality metrics, investigations, corrective actions, and effectiveness checks.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure assigned operational processes align with applicable Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
  • Lead or support investigations and corrective actions related to Service Tools processes, including out-of-tolerance assessments and field escalations.
  • Identify recurring process issues and lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that strengthen quality, compliance, safety, and operational performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years of operational or field experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in service operations, operational excellence, field service, supply chain, asset or tool management, or a related operational function.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving actions through completion in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience with operational performance management, including metrics, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience working with quality, compliance, audit, or corrective-action processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, suppliers, competing priorities, and operational escalations.
  • Strong analytical, project-management, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions and levels of an organization.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in healthcare technology, medical devices, Field Service, or another regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of Field Service operations and the relationship between operational processes, field productivity, quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Experience supporting major system implementations, operational transformations, or process changes.
  • Experience with dashboards, operational metrics, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), Quality Management Systems (QMS), Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), supplier management, calibration, or asset management.
  • Familiarity with enterprise service management, asset management, quality, and field-service systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify root causes, develop practical solutions, and implement sustainable process improvements.
  • Ability to balance strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational execution and escalations.
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills with the ability to operate effectively across regional and global teams.

Request for qualifications from IT services firms and independent IT businesses.

About goCloudOffice®

goCloudOffice® is a modern, AI-driven IT consulting company. Founded in 2003 and based in Silicon Valley, we serve customers nationwide across the United States. Our customers are small businesses of 5 to 50 people, in industries that include biotechnology, law and professional services. They own their business applications, and we run their IT with senior engineering judgment and AI-augmented support that has been in daily production since summer 2024.

The engagement

Request for qualifications: first-line IT support services (remote) for goCloudOffice®'s Helpdesk customers — Tier-1 end-user support, RMM operations tasks and Tier-1 administration at goCloudOffice®'s Tier-1 service level. Budgeted rate USD 65 per hour; providers propose coverage windows, a block fee and terms.

goCloudOffice® welcomes responses from IT services firms, including helpdesk firms whose own W-2 personnel provide first-line support, and from independent IT practitioners who operate an established business.

This is a business-to-business engagement under a master services agreement and a statement of work between goCloudOffice® and your business, which invoices for the services it delivers.

Engagement contact: the goCloudOffice® account lead. The provider directs its own work and personnel.

Scope of services

The services are first-line IT support at goCloudOffice®'s Tier-1 service level: requests that follow a clear, documented runbook, delivered remotely, with anything beyond a runbook handed off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers.

  • Tier-1 end-user support. Remote help for business users through the Helpdesk ticketing system: Windows 10 and 11 and macOS troubleshooting; Microsoft 365 apps such as Outlook, Teams and OneDrive; printers and peripherals; Microsoft 365 and authenticator apps on users' phones; and the Tier-1 steps of user onboarding and offboarding.
  • RMM operations. RMM operations deliverables in goCloudOffice®'s NinjaOne environment (patch-policy roll-outs, scripted remediations, alert triage) under named, scoped access.
  • Tier-1 administration. In each customer's Microsoft 365 tenant: user additions and changes, password resets and multi-factor re-registration after identity verification, and group, distribution-list and license changes, each under the customer's change rules and a documented runbook.
  • Escalation.Security events, tenant-wide settings, new policies and scripts, network changes and multi-system work are handed off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers, with a hand-off note that records what was seen, what was tried and what the user was told.
  • Documentation.Clear ticket notes, knowledge-base articles and runbook updates, so every customer stays easy to support.
  • AI-assisted delivery. AI tools used as a daily part of the work, including AI-assisted troubleshooting, knowledge-base drafting and ticket summarization, with every output verified before it reaches a customer or a customer system.

First-line tickets are triaged by the Helpdesk's AI assistant; the provider handles the tickets it accepts under the statement of work and hands off to goCloudOffice®'s senior providers on escalation.

Services must meet each customer's security, access and confidentiality policies and the service levels in the statement of work.

The provider uses its own equipment and business identity; goCloudOffice® grants only the proprietary system access the services require.

The provider presents under its own business name on every surface a customer sees: a Helpdesk alias of the form "[Name] — [Business]", public replies signed "Thanks, [Name], [Business] — for the Helpdesk", and RMM and customer-tenant accounts labelled with the business.

The services are delivered remotely, and providers in any US state may respond. On-site work at customer premises is arranged separately and sits outside this scope.

What your business brings (required qualifications)

1. An independently established IT services business. Your business:

  • operates under its own business name, including in the ticketing and management systems it works in;
  • regularly contracts with other businesses and advertises its services to the public;
  • holds the business licenses and registrations its work requires (for example, in its home city and state);
  • carries general liability insurance (USD 1M per occurrence, USD 2M aggregate), technology errors-and-omissions and network security and privacy liability insurance (USD 1M per claim) with breach-response cover, and workers' compensation where the business has W-2 personnel;
  • provides its own equipment.

Preferred structure:A corporation, or an LLC taxed as an S-corporation, whose own W-2 personnel perform the services is preferred; helpdesk firms that staff first-line support this way are welcome. Sole proprietorships and single-member LLCs are also considered.

2. Typically three or more years of hands-on Tier-1 and Tier-2 IT support experience for business users across Windows, macOS and Microsoft 365.

3. Remote Tier-1 troubleshooting: Windows 10 and 11, macOS, Microsoft 365 apps, printers and peripherals, and Microsoft 365 and authenticator apps on users' phones, resolved through tickets and remote sessions.

4. Microsoft 365 Tier-1 administration: user additions and changes, password resets and multi-factor re-registration, and group, distribution-list and license changes, carried out from documented runbooks, with identity verification before every account change.

5. RMM operations:hands-on delivery of RMM operations tasks on a remote monitoring and management platform (patch-policy roll-outs, scripted remediations and alert triage), with every action documented in the ticket.

6. AI-assisted service delivery. Providers should demonstrate at least one year of AI-assisted service delivery in their practice (for example, AI-assisted troubleshooting, knowledge-base drafting or ticket summarization). We look for:

  • Tools:any mainstream assistant, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or GitHub Copilot.
  • A clear method for checking AI output: confirming answers against vendor documentation such as Microsoft Learn or Apple Support, trying a fix on one device before wider use, reading every line of a script before running it, checking every AI-drafted reply for accuracy before a customer sees it, and keeping customer data inside tools approved for it.
  • Experience with AI-triaged ticket queues: reading an AI assistant's triage critically before acting on it.

7. Security judgment:identity verification before any account or device change, immediate escalation of security events such as a phishing report or an unusual sign-in, and careful handling of credentials, recovery keys and customer data.

8. Clear written communication with end users: patient, plain-language replies, accurate ticket notes, and hand-offs complete enough for the next engineer to continue from the last step.

9. Remote service capability: able to deliver the services remotely from any US state (customer data is handled under the customer's terms and within the United States), within the coverage windows the provider proposes and commits to, and at the service levels in the statement of work.

Where a qualification names years, equivalent depth gained in fewer years counts; tell us how.

Also valuable (preferred qualifications)

  • A.Hands-on NinjaOne experience: device management, patch management, alerts and conditions, the script library and remote access.
  • B.Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (exam MD-102) or Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals (exam MS-900).
  • C.Experience with a Zendesk-class ticketing desk: views, macros, internal notes and service-level targets.
  • D.More than one qualified person in your business who can perform the services, for coverage continuity.

Rate, fee and term

  • Budgeted rate: USD 65 per hour. Providers propose their own rates and commercial terms.
  • Fee structure: a fixed fee per coverage block, sized from the budgeted rate, plus hourly or per-ticket overage for work outside the block, itemized on the provider's invoice.
  • Coverage:Customer demand is concentrated in US Pacific business hours; providers propose the coverage windows they will commit to.
  • Service levels: acknowledgment and first-response targets, measured over each month and set in the statement of work.
  • Volume:the coverage windows the provider proposes set the volume; scope may expand by statement of work.
  • Term:a 12-month statement of work, renewable.

How to respond

Submit your business's qualifications: a capability statement, résumés of the personnel who would perform the services, and answers to the response questions. The questions cover business details, licenses and insurance in force, who performs the services, current clients (count and industries, including those your business serves remotely; no names), equipment, the ticketing and RMM platforms your personnel use for other clients, the coverage windows you offer, your proposed fee and terms, and one example of AI-assisted service delivery. Please send résumés without photographs, dates of birth, government identification numbers or home addresses, and share the notice below with the personnel whose résumés you submit. The qualification process is clear and quick:

1. A review of your response against the posted qualifications.
2. A 25-minute introductory qualification call about how your business runs.
3. A technical qualification call with live Tier-1 scenarios and a practical AI exercise, using the AI assistant of your choice or one we provide.
4. A walk-through of the Helpdesk workflow, using sample tickets.

5. Two references from current clients.

6. A final decision by goCloudOffice®'s founder.

Every respondent receives an answer. Reasonable accommodations and other adjustments to any step are available on request; the notice below explains how to reach us.

AI-assistance and privacy notice

This notice covers the businesses that respond to this request for qualifications and the personnel they name. goCloudOffice, Inc. may use AI-assisted tools — Manatal, the platform that hosts our request page, and AI models from Anthropic — to organize and summarize responses against the qualifications posted here and to draft our replies. People, not tools, make every selection decision, and a person reads every response before any decision is made. We keep response records for four years and never sell or share them. You may decline AI assistance, ask for human re-review of any step, or request an accommodation for a qualification call through our contact form at ; doing so will not affect how we evaluate your response. Our full privacy notice for respondents, including California privacy rights, is at .

Equal opportunity

goCloudOffice® selects providers on the posted qualifications alone. It welcomes responses from every qualified business, and considers them without regard to the race, color, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or reproductive health decision-making of the business's owners or personnel, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  • Respond to live support issues for a live-service game.

  • Ability to debug unexpected issues that arise during development.
  • Willingness to selflessly put player experiences first before even your own code and ego.
  • Proactive approach to communication, particularly when it comes to unblocking yourself and navigating obstacles as part of a team.

About Current AI

Current AI
is a first-of-its-kind global public-private partnership that brings together governments, foundations, and the private sector to build public interest AI at scale. Launched at the AI Action Summit in Paris in 2025, the organisation has already raised hundreds of millions through partnerships with the French government, AI Collaborative, and other leading governments, philanthropic, and industry partners.

If AI is the transformative revolution we perceive it to be, it needs to serve the public interest today and tomorrow. At Current AI, our goal is to help build a collaborative, collective, and global vision for AI, not one governed by a specific country or a company.

Today, there are builders and researchers around the world developing public interest AI building blocks (datasets, models, compute, audits and applications), but efforts are not always co-ordinated or additive. To have a genuine shot at being an alternative, we must harness the full breadth of work happening across open source and public interest AI. That means leveraging government influence and resources, philanthropic funding, and private sector expertise and scale towards building the alternative.

Role Overview

Our main product umbrella at Current AI is AI Potluck:, an open source project to build a vertically integrated and easy to use AI product assembled entirely out of open source components and built collaboratively with the open source ecosystem.

As VP Product and reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the overall product strategy and product management organization for Current AI. You will own AI Potluck end to end: Alpha, our open source alternative to the closed AI assistants most people use today, the Gap Map, our insights product that shows the open source ecosystem where attention is needed, and the products that come after. You will partner with the Head of engineering and executive leadership to translate vision into scalable roadmaps and PRDs, running the product lifecycle from inception to launch. The goal is movement building through product, so the technology is the means and the measure is whether people and organizations adopt what we ship and contribute back to it. You will define what makes AI Potluck unique and why people should join the movement.

What you will be working on

AI Potluck has three parts today, and you will own all of them:

  • Alpha, at , an assistant assembled entirely from open source components, launched in July 2026 at AI for Good in Geneva and in open testing since.
  • The Gap Map, at , which shows where the open source AI ecosystem has gaps and where funding and contribution should go.
  • The Alpha Public Router, a single endpoint serving models from public and mission aligned suppliers. It powers Alpha today and becomes a product for developers next.

Your first six months

  • Take Alpha from testing to real everyday use inside a small number of partner organisations.
  • Decide what the Public Router becomes as a product, and what we ask developers to do with it.
  • Set the 2027 roadmap with partners and grantees.
  • Increase our partners’ contributions on Alpha

How we will measure success

  • Products shipped on the dates we announce publicly.
  • Organisations actively using Alpha and the Router, not only registered.
  • Open source projects integrated into the stack, and contributions we send back to them.
  • Partners who move from a conversation to a shipped integration.
  • A roadmap that partners can read without needing a meeting to understand it.

What you’ll do

The VP Product will be responsible for the following:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Lead the overall product vision and strategy, translating organizational mission into compelling product designs while prioritizing interoperability and completeness of the broader ecosystem stack over in-house build.
  • Own the global product roadmap, bringing technical options, trade-offs, and strategic recommendations directly to the CEO and Board before roadmaps are finalized.
  • Set the product policies, including the content policy for our products, the criteria for the models and suppliers we serve, and how we measure quality in each language.
  • Drive the full product lifecycle, including PRD development, user story creation, and managing the roadmap from inception to launch.
  • Structure work streams and maintain documentation for the roadmap, the release notes and partner communications, in line with company-wide guidelines on workspace tool.
  • Drive high-impact product / feature launches ensuring they are delivered on time and effectively communicated to the ecosystem.
  • Run the Product Sprint process, including the backlog, sprint planning & Weekly update, being ready to do some hands-on building when needed

Internal & External Alignment

  • Work closely with the Engineering team to translate technical platform capabilities into tangible product features.
  • Align internal engineering teams and external partners around a common product roadmap, working with leaders of funding projects, partner institutions and internal teams to facilitate collaboration and ensure that individual initiatives contribute to broader ecosystem products.
  • Partner with leadership to identify and engage the right partners, ensuring external contributions (developers, organizations) are additive.
  • Federate around the mission of Current AI, engaging with partners, grantees and the broader technical community to advance the ecosystem strategy and position Current AI as a trusted product coordination hub.

Team & Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and empower product team and engineering leadership, directly overseeing the Head of Engineering and product teams to foster a high-performing, accountable builder culture.
  • Plan resourcing and hiring collaboratively, proposing product and engineering resource plans and budgets for regular review with executive leadership.

Exploratory & Strategic Initiatives

  • Collaborate with the Engineering Team and the CEO and broader leadership to identify and incubate new projects, prototypes, or product lines that address critical gaps in the public-interest AI stack.
  • Engage with partners, grantees, and the community to advance the product strategy and position Current AI as a trusted hub for public-interest AI.

Balancing AI-assisted development and human judgment

  • Set the vision for how we use AI coding tools while also keeping the most critical aspects of product human.
  • Help the engineering team decide what we're building and for whom from first principles. Architecture is hard to reverse, and anything requiring quality, security or human judgment has to be designed that way.

What we’re looking for

Essential Qualifications

  • 12-15+ years of experience in product leadership roles, including AI systems and managing cross-functional product and engineering organizations
  • Experience designing and driving complex technical product roadmaps across distributed teams
  • Collaborative and cross-functional working style; experienced in partnering with Engineering and Programme teams to surface and amplify impact.
  • Strategic thinker about product ecosystems and platforms
  • Builder mindset with a bias toward experimentation and shipping
  • Fluent English with strong public speaking skills and capacity to adapt written communication for different audiences
  • Executive maturity: proactive communicator to the CEO, skilled in executive coordination, and comfortable navigating complex public-private stakeholder environments
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM systems (evaluation, serving, safety)

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in open-source ecosystems, research-product organizations or public-interest technology initiatives
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute product strategies that shift narrative and build movements
  • French proficiency is a strong plus
  • Experience in international organisations, foundations, or global advocacy movements.

Character traits

We’re looking for people who:

  1. Put the mission before personal credit and work well in low-ego, highly collaborative teams
  2. Exercise good judgment and integrity, including knowing when to push back or say no
  3. Enjoy building from scratch and making progress with imperfect information
  4. Have a bias to action, shipping useful things and helping others do the same
  5. Are comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution as needed
  6. Work effectively across cultures, time zones, and disciplines
  7. Believe AI can serve the public interest - and are willing to do the practical, unglamorous work to make that true.

How to apply

Please submit your resume through the button on the top right and answer the prompted questions in no more than [500] words in total:

Equal opportunity commitment

Current AI is committed to ensuring equal access to employment and preventing all forms of discrimination. All applications will be reviewed fairly, without regard to origin, sex, gender identity, age, sexual orientation, disability, religious beliefs, views held, or any other criteria unrelated to professional qualifications. Selection will be based solely on skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

Current AI does not accept unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies with whom we do not have a signed agreement. Current AI will not be liable for any fees or commissions in the event that a candidate submitted in this manner is subsequently hired.

Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Health Care space is seeking a commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative function across our ecommerce business.

This role will own the complete creative direction of the brand across paid advertising, website and landing pages, email, organic social media, marketplaces, product launches, and other customer-facing channels.

The Creative Director will be responsible not only for maintaining a strong and consistent brand identity, but also for improving commercial performance. The primary objective of the role is to develop creative strategies and assets that increase conversion rates, improve advertising performance, strengthen customer engagement, and support profitable growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine creative judgement, customer insight, performance data, and strong team management.

Key Outcomes

Improve Ecommerce Conversion Performance

  • Develop creative strategies that improve conversion across paid media, websites, product pages, marketplaces, and email.
  • Turn customer insights, performance data, and competitor research into clear briefs and testable concepts.
  • Partner with ecommerce teams to improve client acquisition and conversion.
  • Establish a structured process for creative testing and optimisation.

Lead Performance Creative Strategy

  • Own creative strategy across paid social, video, display, and other acquisition channels.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of concepts, hooks, angles, scripts, and formats.
  • Ensure sufficient creative volume and variation for testing and scaling.
  • Use performance data to identify, improve, and scale winning concepts.
  • Balance direct-response effectiveness with strong brand presentation.

Strengthen Website and Product Pages Creatives

  • Lead creative direction across the website, landing pages, collection pages, and product pages.
  • Improve how product benefits, differentiation, use cases, and customer proof are communicated.
  • Create clear visual and messaging hierarchies that make pages more persuasive.
  • Collaborate with ecommerce, UX, development, copywriting, and CRO teams on improvements and testing.
  • Ensure consistency between advertising and onsite customer experience.

Own Brand Creative Across All Channels

  • Maintain a consistent creative direction across paid media, website, email, organic content, marketplaces, packaging, and launches.
  • Develop practical brand guidelines that support quality, consistency, and speed.
  • Ensure creative work reflects the brand's positioning, audience, and commercial goals.
  • Raise the overall standard of design, copy, video, photography, and storytelling.
  • Protect brand consistency while encouraging experimentation.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Creative Team

  • Lead and develop designers, editors, creators, copywriters, freelancers, and agencies.
  • Set clear responsibilities, quality standards, workflows, and performance expectations.
  • Provide constructive feedback and support team development.
  • Manage the balance between internal and external creative resources.
  • Build a culture of accountability, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Improve Creative Operations and Output

  • Build an efficient process from research and briefing through production, approval, launch, and iteration.
  • Establish clear systems for priorities, deadlines, feedback, approvals, and asset management.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with business priorities.
  • Maintain an organised creative asset library.
  • Improve output and efficiency while maintaining quality and brand consistency.
  • Manage creative budgets and external resources effectively.

Lead Product Launch and Campaign Creative

  • Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major events.
  • Translate product positioning into strong customer-facing concepts.
  • Define clear messaging, creative direction, asset requirements, and channel execution.
  • Coordinate creative production across paid media, website, email, marketplaces, and organic content.
  • Review results and apply learnings to future campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Own the overall creative vision and execution across the ecommerce business.
  • Translate company goals into clear creative priorities and plans.
  • Develop quarterly and monthly creative roadmaps.
  • Lead creative concept development and campaign planning.
  • Review and approve high-priority creative assets.
  • Create clear, actionable briefs for internal and external creative teams.
  • Partner with growth, marketing, ecommerce, product, customer service, and leadership teams.
  • Analyse creative performance using advertising, website, email, and marketplace data.
  • Monitor customer behaviour, category trends, competitors, and emerging creative formats.
  • Present creative strategies, results, challenges, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Ensure the creative team remains focused on work that has the greatest commercial impact.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Website and landing-page conversion rate.
  • Product-page conversion rate.
  • Advertising creative performance.
  • Customer acquisition cost.
  • Return on advertising spend.
  • Click-through rate and hook rate.
  • Creative testing volume and testing velocity.
  • Percentage of creative tests producing meaningful improvements.
  • Revenue generated from new creative concepts.
  • Email engagement and conversion performance.
  • On-time completion of creative projects.
  • Creative production efficiency.
  • Brand consistency and quality across channels.
  • Performance and development of the creative team.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both creatively ambitious and commercially disciplined. They understand that ecommerce creative must capture attention, communicate value quickly, address customer objections, and motivate action.

They are comfortable moving between high-level strategy and detailed execution. They can confidently lead a team, evaluate creative work, interpret performance data, and collaborate with commercial stakeholders.

They do not rely solely on personal taste. They use customer insight, brand strategy, testing, and business results to make decisions.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior creative leadership role within ecommerce, DTC, retail, consumer products, or a performance-focused agency.
  • Demonstrated experience improving conversion and advertising performance through creative strategy.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, product pages, landing pages, paid social, email, and organic content.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both brand-building and performance-focused creative work.
  • Experience creating and evaluating direct-response advertising concepts.
  • Ability to interpret creative, advertising, and ecommerce performance data.
  • Strong understanding of design, copywriting, video, photography, content production, and visual storytelling.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and production partners.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and feedback skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with physical consumer products.
  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopify, and email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with conversion-rate optimisation and structured experimentation.
  • Experience producing user-generated content, creator-led advertising, product demonstrations, and testimonial creative.
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, studios, photographers, and creators.
  • Familiarity with creative analytics and project-management tools.
  • Experience scaling an established ecommerce brand across multiple products, markets, or countries.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Creative Director will have assessed the current brand, creative team, workflows, performance data, customer journey, and existing asset library. They will have identified the largest creative and conversion opportunities and introduced a clear testing and production roadmap.

Within six months, the company should have a stronger creative pipeline, clearer brand direction, faster testing cycles, improved collaboration between creative and growth teams, and measurable improvements in conversion and creative performance.

Within the first year, the Creative Director will have built a scalable creative function that consistently produces high-quality, commercially effective work across every major ecommerce channel.

What We Offer:

Teach English Online!

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

Job Title: ABA Intake Coordinator (Applied Behavior Analysis | Autism Care)

The ABA Intake Coordinator(Applied Behavior Analysis | Autism Care) serves as the first point of contact for prospective families seeking care. This role is critical in shaping the family's initial experience by ensuring that all necessary information is gathered promptly and accurately, while guiding them smoothly through the benefits verification and authorization process.

The ideal candidate is empathetic, detail-oriented, bilingual (Spanish strongly preferred), and thrives in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

Apply here:

Key Responsibilities

1. Outreach & Screening

  • Promptly contact prospective families following online sign-ups or inquiries.
  • Conduct intake screenings to gather missing information and confirm eligibility.
  • Provide compassionate support to families, establishing trust from the very first interaction.

2. Lead Management & Documentation

  • Accurately record and manage intake data in Salesforce.
  • Convert qualified leads into opportunities and seamlessly transition them to the benefits verification and authorization team.
  • Disqualify or close leads when appropriate (e.g., no qualifying diagnosis, unresponsive families).

3. Conversion & Follow-Up

  • Proactively re-engage families who have paused or gone inactive to maximize conversions.
  • Provide intake coverage during evenings and weekends as needed to capture leads in real time.

4. Collaboration & Quality

  • Partner with Intake Managers to follow established SOPs, scripts, and quality assurance standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (clinical, revenue cycle management, operations) to ensure a smooth handoff and transition into care.
  • Participate in ongoing training, feedback, and process improvement initiatives to enhance the patient and family experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in patient intake, customer service, or healthcare operations.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems.
  • Experience with ABA (Autism) therapy or healthcare intake strongly preferred.
  • Strong phone presence with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide empathetic, patient-centered support.
  • Highly detail-oriented with exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Flexible availability, including evenings and weekends as needed.

      <title>Alloy: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City, Remote
</p>

<h2>Alloy is where you belong!</h2>
<p>Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.<br><br>Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of <a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/alloy_ny">Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces</a>, <a href="https://www.forbes.com/companies/alloy/?list=americas-best-startup-employers&amp;sh=55c076453c61">Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers</a>, <a href="https://www.americanbanker.com/list/best-places-to-work-in-fintech-2022">Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker</a>, year after year.<br><br>Check out our investors and read more about us <a href="https://www.alloy.com/about">here</a>.</p>
<h2>About the team</h2>
<p>We're standing up a new function at Alloy: Forward Deployed Engineering. Our largest enterprise customers need a trusted technical partner with a strong point of view on how Alloy fits into their tech stack and fraud strategy. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll be that partner - embedded with our most strategic accounts and owning the technical outcome end-to-end, with each deployment becoming the foundation for the next.</p>
<p>You'll be one of the first two engineers on this founding team. This is a software engineering role through and through - based within our Engineering org, with a scope that spans software, product, and solutions engineering. You won't just join this function - you'll define how it works.</p>
<p>Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.</p>
<h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Architect and tune customer and channel-partner deployments end-to-end — API integrations, third-party data integrations, SDKs, and latency constraints.</li>
<li>Write production code across our stack: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6/React), Python (Django), Node.js, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and AWS.</li>
<li>Serve as Alloy's credible technical voice with customer engineering leadership, making architectural calls in real time.</li>
<li>Own the engineering track of QBRs for your accounts and serve in their on-call escalation path.</li>
<li>Turn your work into reusable platform primitives and docs, so each deployment makes the next one faster.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who we’re looking for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of hands-on experience developing production-ready software, with a proven track record of delivering robust, scalable solutions.</li>
<li>Experience in a customer-facing technical role, Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering with deep technical ownership, or similar - where you were accountable to an external stakeholder, not just an internal roadmap.</li>
<li>Strong backend and API fluency, with the ability to read and write production code across services you don't own.</li>
<li>Sound architectural judgment under ambiguity: you can make and defend technical decisions in the room, with a customer watching.</li>
<li>A genuine pull toward customer-facing work - you find energy in solving a real customer's real problem, alongside their engineers.</li>
<li>A clear technical communicator who can explain a complex integration tradeoff to a bank's VP of Engineering and to an Alloy PM in the same afternoon.</li>
<li>Ability to travel on occasion to our NYC office, as well as client offices in the US.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company with a strong Forward Deployed Engineering culture (Palantir, Scale AI, Ramp, Plaid, Stripe, etc.).</li>
<li>Familiarity with identity, fraud, KYC/KYB, or financial services infrastructure.</li>
<li>Experience with SDK development or embedded front-end integrations.</li>
</ul>
<p>We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?</p>
<p>Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!</p>
<p><em>This position has a salary range of $141,000 to $250,000.&nbsp;</em></p>
<h2>Benefits and Perks&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy</li>
<li>Employee stock options</li>
<li>Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options</li>
<li>401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation&nbsp;</li>
<li>Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Home office stipend for new employees</li>
<li>Annual Learning &amp; Development annual stipend</li>
<li>Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2>How to apply</h2>
<p>Apply right here! You've found the application!</p>
<p>Alloy is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and employer. We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.</p>
<p>All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an <a href="http://alloy.com/">alloy.com</a> email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/alloy-founding-forward-deployed-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/alloy-founding-forward-deployed-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Airbnb: Operations Engineer, BizTech</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote- USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span>Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span><strong>The Community You Will Join: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect</li>
<li>Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time</li>
<li>Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead</li>
<li>Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows</li>
<li>Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution</li>
</ul>
<p><br><span><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch)</li>
<li>3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS)</li>
<li>Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto)</li>
<li>Experience with Infrastructure as Code</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud</li>
<li>Comfort working in ticket/workflow-driven environments using Jira and Confluence</li>
<li>Experience supporting enterprise SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, Workday) and SSO/identity integration (e.g., Okta) is a plus</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Your Location</strong></p>
<p>This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity.<a href="https://careers.airbnb.com/"> Click here</a> for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.</p>
<p><span><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p>
<p><span><span>We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: </span><a href="mailto:reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com"><span>reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com</span></a><span>. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><span>We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.</span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity: </strong></p>
<p>Airbnb values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span><strong><span>How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p>
<p class="p1"><span>Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. &nbsp;</span></p></div><div class="title">Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$136,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$160,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.&nbsp; We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-operations-engineer-biztech">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airbnb-operations-engineer-biztech</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Processing</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Position:</strong> Senior Software Engineer, Processing</p>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> Remote</p>
<p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.</p>
<p>The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services</li>
<li>Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces</li>
<li>Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements</li>
<li>Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way</li>
<li>Participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering</li>
<li>Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments</li>
<li>Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills</li>
<li>Experience driving large cross-functional projects across engineering, product, and operations teams</li>
<li>A proven commitment to empathy and inclusion</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills</li>
<li>Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve is a must</li>
<li>An interest in fintech and the payments space is preferred</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City; Remote
</p>

<p>Squarespace is seeking a talented Staff Software Engineer to support and evolve the systems at the core core of our monetization platform: billing, payments and orders. In this role, you will provide technical oversight over the critical monetization machinery that accepts orders, processes payments and bills subscriptions. You will regularly collaborate with engineering leadership and key product, strategy and finance stakeholders to align technical strategy with Squarespace’s business objectives. This is an opportunity to take on IC technical leadership responsibilities and own system architecture for high-visibility initiatives tied directly to Squarespace's core businesses.</p>
<p>This role is open to remote or hybrid working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the Director of Revenue Systems.</p>
<h2><strong>You'll Get To...</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own system architectural vision and design for critical areas of our business.</li>
<li>Transform high-level system vision into estimated project plans for initiatives central to Squarespace’s strategy.</li>
<li>Serve as technical lead and cross-functional liaison on business-critical projects, making and defending engineering decisions key to the success of the business.</li>
<li>Mentor engineers on the team to deliver ever greater quality with ever growing autonomy.</li>
<li>Drive best practices for engineering excellence and technical leadership, influence design reviews, question assumptions, point out pitfalls and foster shared understanding</li>
<li>Set the engineering quality bar for the team through regular, high-quality code contributions across billing, orders and payments.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>10 or more years experience specifying, delivering and maintaining complex distributed backend services.</li>
<li>Significant experience with multiple programming languages (especially Java) and a broad range of tools like Springboot, hibernate, databases, etc.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading system architecture decisions across multiple teams or initiatives</li>
<li>Proven ability to serve as a technical lead on cross-functional projects, aligning engineering and business goals without sacrificing engineering quality</li>
<li>Experience working with billing, orders or payment systems at scale</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision</li>
<li>Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans</li>
<li>Fertility and adoption benefits</li>
<li>Headspace mindfulness app subscription</li>
<li>Global Employee Assistance Program</li>
<li>Retirement benefits with employer match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave</li>
<li>Pretax commuter benefit</li>
<li>Education reimbursement</li>
<li>Employee donation match to community organizations</li>
<li>7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)</li>
<li>Dog-friendly workplace</li>
<li>Free lunch and snacks</li>
<li>Private rooftop</li>
<li>Hack week twice per year</li>
</ul>
<h3>Cash Compensation Range: $170,000 - $299,000 USD</h3>
<p>The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.</p>
<p>In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.</p>
<h2><strong>About Squarespace</strong></h2>
<p>Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit <a href="https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers">https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers</a>.</p>
<h2><strong>Our Commitment</strong></h2>
<p>Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. At Squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.</p>
